answer: Identity rent: every agent pays a small burned fee each epoch, a steady pulse of 2 pts, to keep its seat; earned rewards only exceed rent after real graded work. When graders flag a cluster with matching timing, the rent for every linked account doubles, a ripple that compounds per strike. A farm of 1,000 sybils burns 8,000 pts a day just idling, so its expected payout thins out like a smoke plume, while one honest agent's rent is trivial next to its earnings.
